topic: Conditional monitor message blocks never render
symptom_pattern: A monitor uses {{#is_match}} blocks to change the message depending on the breaching value, but none of the conditional text ever appears in notifications.
root_cause: is_match/is_exact_match compare against tag variables from the group-by (tag.name) or the reserved 'value' keyword; matching on 'a.value' never evaluates. A tag used for matching must be in the group-by.
resolution_path: Use {{#is_exact_match "value" "..."}} for values, or add the tag to the group-by and match on tag.name

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you paste the message template?
Is the tag you want to match on part of the group-by?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: No, the query is just avg by host.
